question: Pipes A and B can fill a water tank in 5 and 35 hours respectively. Both are opened together, and A is closed after 4 hours. In how many more hours will B fill the rest?
solution: The tank = 35 units. 4 hours together: 4 × 8 = 32. Left 3; B fills 1 an hour: 3 ÷ 1 = 3 hours.

question: Pipes P and Q can fill a tank in 6 and 12 hours respectively. Both are opened together, but P is closed 6 hours before the tank is full. In how many hours is it full?
solution: The tank = 12 units; P 2, Q 1 an hour. If it takes x hours, P runs x − 6: 2(x − 6) + 1x = 12, so 3x = 24 and x = 8 hours.
questionHi: पाइप P और Q एक टंकी को क्रमशः 6 और 12 घंटे में भर सकते हैं। दोनों एक साथ खोले जाते हैं, पर टंकी भरने से 6 घंटे पहले P बंद कर दिया जाता है। वह कितने घंटे में भरेगी?
solutionHi: टंकी = 12 इकाई; P 2, Q 1 प्रति घंटा। यदि x घंटे लगें, P x − 6 घंटे चला: 2(x − 6) + 1x = 12, अतः 3x = 24 और x = 8 घंटे।

question: A water tank is full. Pipe A can empty it in 12 hours and pipe B can fill it in 48 hours. If both are opened together, in how many hours will it be empty?
solution: The tank = 48 units. A lets out 4, B puts in 1: net 3 out an hour. Time = 48 ÷ 3 = 16 hours.

question: A pipe can fill a water tank in 4 hours, but with a leak it takes 8 hours. The leak lets out 17 litres a minute. What is the capacity of the tank?
solution: The pipe fills 1/4 of it an hour; with the leak only 1/8 stays, so the leak takes out 1/4 − 1/8 an hour and empties it alone in 4 × 8 ÷ (8 − 4) = 8 hours = 480 minutes. At 17 litres a minute that is 480 × 17 = 8160 litres.
questionHi: एक पाइप पानी की एक टंकी को 4 घंटे में भर सकता है, पर रिसाव के कारण 8 घंटे लगते हैं। रिसाव से प्रति मिनट 17 लीटर पानी निकलता है। टंकी की क्षमता कितनी है?
solutionHi: रिसाव अकेला टंकी को 4 × 8 ÷ (8 − 4) = 8 घंटे = 480 मिनट में खाली करता है। 17 लीटर प्रति मिनट से क्षमता = 480 × 17 = 8160 लीटर।
